dialogues.speaker: Menthe
dialogues.text: Thank you, kind soul. Would you be willing to hear a Melusine's troubles?

dialogues.speaker: Menthe
dialogues.text: Perhaps I'm at fault for having been too enthusiastic about integrating into human life, but I've gradually found that there are a lot of difficult things to adapt to.

dialogues.speaker: Menthe
dialogues.text: Humans use such... large things in their daily lives. Take clothes for example — sure, we can just buy a shirt and use it as a dress, too, but we still need to get the cuffs tailored...

dialogues.speaker: Menthe
dialogues.text: And if we want to rent an apartment, we can only buy children's furniture — and even then, I have to step on a stool to reach the windows...

dialogues.speaker: Menthe
dialogues.text: If only I had a body like Sigewinne's... or maybe I should just go underwater...
